scope: Opt-in pure form and sequential-continuation census of byte-proven code16 WASM refusals; no guest execution or ordinary path change

validation.guestParity: Pinned private 60-million-step serial ordinary/form-census reports matched after dropping source/revision and opt-in-only metadata; both stopped at budget without refusal

measurementProvenance: Both raw reports directly record the new form parser, dispatcher, and CLI source SHA-256, identical to this candidate. Media identifiers, raw reports and timing remain in the private evidence repository.
interpretation: These are dispatcher-call frequencies, not distinct instructions, native retirements, or a speed projection. The first bounded execution candidate is 0x26-prefixed read-only 8A/8B loads and 3A byte compare using the existing ES EA/data proof. Segment-cache mutations in 8E, mixed 32-bit semantics in 66, stack effects and writes need separate fault-ordering work. Terminal branch fallthrough bytes are excluded from sequential-continuation inference.
